facts.text: Students completing 45 credits at a regional campus with a 3.0 GPA receive guaranteed transfer relocation to the Pittsburgh campus's Dietrich School.

sources.title: Enrollment Services | University of Pittsburgh at Bradford
sources.quote: For students seeking guaranteed transfer relocation who have earned credits only from one of the regional campuses, the normal requirement is for completion of 45 credits at the specific regional campus, with a minimum GPA of 3.0.
